text_block_list.text: On this day, I was invited to a Mejiro family gathering and came along with Mejiro Dober.
"She seemed busy chatting with relatives, so I dined alone, but..."
Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No way, no way, no way!
Wait, wait, when did you get here!?
Waaahh...!!

They are cheering louder than I've ever seen before.
Wondering what happened,
I tried to see what was going on, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: It's rare to see Dober that happy, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"You might have heard about this before,
but that lady is like a
'second mother' to Dober."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Shortly after Dober was born,
her mother was going through a very busy period with her modeling work..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: During that time, that lady was the one looking after Dober. I hear she took her out to play at all sorts of places and things like that.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ma'am~!
The food here is so good~!

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text:
Right, right? The food here is delicious~!
I used to come here a lot with Dober's mom back in the day.

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text: And we'd always overeat, so going for a run together afterward was just part of the routine!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Her mom is...?
Then I wanna race with your mom too!

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text:
Alright~
But only after you finish all your kid's meal, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...And so,
Dober truly looks up to her aunt, who was always there by her side.
choice_data_list: In that case, it's best not to disturb them.
In that case, it's best not to disturb them.

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text: Long time no see, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, you should've told me beforehand if you were coming.
I would've dressed up much nicer!

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're plenty cute right now.
How have you been lately? Tell me all about what's going on at the academy!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Of course! You see—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Did I mention this before? My roommate at the dorm is from America!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She's hearty, bright, and just someone you can't leave alone;
she's always getting into some kind of trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Just the other day, when I went to a BBQ I was invited to,
they were so focused on bringing the meat
that they completely forgot the charcoal."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"We'd go running together to buy things, and so on.
I was pretty much always dragged around by her like that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Well, stuff like that
can be kind of fun sometimes, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: All that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, there's someone who
cares about me so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You're always working late.
You put yourself second, and no matter how much I tell you to rest, you never listen."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even though they were completely exhausted,
they still worried about me instead.
Weird person, right? But—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Having that person around
also gives me a sense of security...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um, a-anyway!
It's a really great academy, and every day is so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Lady
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, looks like it. Her eyes were sparkling.
That cute smile of hers hasn't changed a bit since she was little.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I can't help it.
Getting to see you makes me happy, Auntie, both back then and now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer.
I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
! Fufu,
as expected of Dober's Trainer.
On the way home that day, having made that promise—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did something good happen?
You've got such a giddy look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, why do you look so happy?
Did something good happen?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... honestly...
I was wondering what it was, but is that all?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I see.
Did you have fun to your heart's content?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Still, I suppose that's to be expected.
The Mejiro family chefs are on par with luxury restaurants, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not every day you get to taste
the cooking of a chef employed by the Mejiros.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More importantly... isn't that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: More importantly... isn't that amazing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Her appetite winning out over nervousness,
even in front of all those prestigious Mejiro Umamusume... *chuckle*
Though I was taken for a glutton, I managed to keep my promise to Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ? I didn't hear anything about anyone seeing something—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ? I didn't hear anything about anyone seeing something—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
“...... Wait.
D-Don't tell me... you saw that...?”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, forget it! I-It's nothing!
If you didn't see anything, fine. End of discussion!

Though feeling a slight pang of guilt,
I faithfully kept my promise to Mejiro Ryan.
